name: Employee Salary Increment History
query:
SELECT
    parent AS "Employee:Link/Employee:200",
    old_salary AS "Old Salary:Currency:120",
    increment_amount AS "Increment Amount:Currency:120",
    new_salary AS "New Salary:Currency:120",
    date AS "Date:Date:120",
    reason AS "Reason:Data:120"
FROM
    `tabEmployee Salary Increment History`
WHERE
    (%(employee)s = "" OR parent = %(employee)s)
AND 
    (
        (%(start_date)s IS NULL AND %(end_date)s IS NULL) 
        OR 
        (date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s)
    );
